mcu_g_0160_20000e36.name: protection_a50_neg_latch
mcu_g_0160_20000e36.description: Latch set from the debounced output of 0x20000CEC, which is 1 while 0x20000A50 is above -0x28000 (-5.0 in Q15). mcu_a50_debounce_latch writes it only while it is 0, so once set it stays set. mcu_0160_080054fc tests it as a gate.

mcu_g_0160_20001fcd.name: protection_drive_inhibit_latch
mcu_g_0160_20001fcd.description: Drive inhibit latch. mcu_update_inhibit_latch_1fcd sets or clears it from the fault flags and the value at 0x20000F30. Nonzero is the active state (probably drive inhibited). It is read by mcu_0160_08003ab8, mcu_0160_08005930, mcu_0160_08005e28, mcu_0160_08005edc, mcu_0160_08008a14 and telemetry.

mcu_g_0160_20001fce.name: protection_cmd_pending
mcu_g_0160_20001fce.description: Command-pending byte. mcu_0160_08007df4 sets it to 1 when a command is queued. mcu_cmd_state_clear clears it, releases owner 10 and clears bit 0x8 of 0x20000B1C. mcu_flag_1fce_is_clear returns 1 when it is zero.
